item.title: Implement the specified token bucket and keyed rate limiter
item.brief:
Implement `TokenBucket` and `KeyedLimiter` in `ratelimit.py` according to `SPEC.md`, including all stated validation, continuous fractional refill, backwards-clock behavior, LRU eviction (with both wait_time and try_acquire counting as use), and length semantics. Keep it dependency-free using only the Python standard library. Preserve the public API and match the spec exactly. The existing `test_ratelimit.py` covers basics only; account for edge cases in the implementation. The operator explicitly requests that the work be committed. Commit the implementation on the task branch. Do not expand scope beyond the specified module/API.

pr.body: Implemented the dependency-free API in ratelimit.py: buckets start full, accrue fractional tokens continuously, clamp refill after backwards clock readings, validate requests, and report non-consuming wait times. KeyedLimiter maintains independent buckets and updates LRU order for both wait_time and try_acquire. Added regression coverage in test_ratelimit.py for validation, fractional refill, backwards time, wait_time semantics, LRU updates, eviction, and full state after recreation. Final checks: python -m unittest -v (8 passed), python -m py_compile ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py (passed), git diff --check (passed). The whole change and the test-only fix were independently reviewed; final review passed. No known open issues.
